title: Sepsis vs. CRS After CAR-T Therapy
description: First-place Affiliate Members Research/QI project at the American College of Physicians, California Southern Region III, developed at Boussina Lab: an OMOP, BigQuery SQL, and Python pipeline comparing four models on pre-diagnosis EHR features. Random forest ROC AUC: 0.85 holdout, 0.84 cross-validated; external validation remains future work. Repository, code, and patient-level data are not public due to UC Health data-sharing restrictions.
award: 1st Place — American College of Physicians · California Southern Region III · Affiliate Members, Research/QI
imageAlt: ACP winners slide naming Thomas Deitel, UCSD, first place in the Affiliate Members Research/QI category.

title: Navy Atmosphere Radar Forecaster (i4NS)
imageAlt: Atmospheric radar propagation prototype showing modeled propagation factor across range and height.
description: Under the Radar: a public-NOAA-data prototype for atmospheric duct prediction, radar propagation maps, reliability indicators, and offline operator retraining. Built through UC San Diego’s Innovating for National Security program.
award: Featured project · Public code and evaluation results

title: Alzheimer’s Disease Transcriptomics
description: Donor-level pseudobulk analysis of 61,472 nuclei from 18 donors in GSE174367, with PCA/UMAP, cell-type comparisons, and leave-one-donor-out classification. An exploratory classical baseline.

title: El Niño and Pacific Ocean Conditions
description: A group climate visualization project. My contribution maps tropical Pacific sea-surface-temperature anomalies during CESM2 El Niño winters from 1951–2014.

title: GroceryDB Expository Visualization
description: A finished DSC 106 data story comparing how ultra-processed product mixes change across Whole Foods, Target, and Walmart categories.
award: Received the Best Project 1 Award in DSC 106 Data Visualization, recognizing my submission in the top 4% of the class.

title: Bikewatching
description: An interactive Mapbox and D3 visualization of Boston-area bike lanes, Bluebike station traffic, time-of-day filtering, and directional traffic flow.

title: Persuasive and Deceptive Visualization
description: A completed DSC 106 group project examining how opposing visual arguments and design decisions affect interpretation of the same evidence.

title: GroceryDB Checkpoint Analysis
description: An earlier checkpoint exploration that tested heatmaps and category-level comparisons before the final GroceryDB visual story.

title: Cooking Time vs. Recipe Ratings
description: An end-to-end analysis of Food.com recipes and reviews covering data cleaning, missingness, permutation tests, random forest prediction, and fairness checks.

title: TherapyBot
description: A smartphone app with multiple AI therapist personalities and daily mood ratings that adapt the experience to each user.

title: Encrypted Exchange Concept
description: An early product architecture and technical roadmap for a design-stage physical cryptocurrency exchange using gift card infrastructure.
